mapping_notice: Mappings are indicative relationships between scanner checks and control objectives. They are not a compliance determination and do not cover the full assessment procedures for any control.

controls.title: Least Privilege
controls.rationale: IAM-001 detects a policy granting all actions on all resources, which directly conflicts with least-privilege access design. The check does not assess every AC-6 requirement.

controls.title: Least Privilege
controls.rationale: IAM-002 identifies broad wildcard permissions that may exceed required access. A wildcard is not always impermissible, so this check is only a partial signal for least-privilege implementation.

controls.title: Access Enforcement
controls.rationale: IAM-004 flags wildcard principals in IAM role trust policies, which may weaken enforcement of intended role-assumption boundaries. It does not evaluate all access-enforcement mechanisms.

controls.title: Boundary Protection
controls.rationale: EC2-001 identifies SSH exposure to the public Internet. This is one network-boundary signal and does not establish that all boundary-protection requirements are satisfied or violated.

controls.title: Protection of Information at Rest
controls.rationale: S3-002 checks S3 bucket encryption configuration. Encryption configuration alone does not establish that all information-at-rest protection requirements, key-management requirements, or data-handling obligations are met.
